description: Teenagers trying their best in this project. Join us if you are intested. Our skills combinded and experiences could make us specialists mainly in animation, data analysis and writing and cummunications. Feel free to join even if you're specializing in the previous skills.
summary: We worked on this project with goal of creating an interplanetary survival guide. We think its important because it contains what the astronaut is gonna need with a guide to help them through the mission.
details: We created the map for the astronaut, they'll carry with them a tablet. We made sure to make it compatible with the problem they may face. With the use of ai we were able to create an html code for the creation of the map. I think our project is creative because we made the map in consideration of many factors and issues the astronaut may face including the routes and geology of the terrains. Other factors we considered were the lack of oxygen they may face, a Glove-Compatible touchscreen display.
